dict.string: Evie uses the camera when you ask her to Look.
Evie uses the microphone so you can talk to her.
Evie uses Contacts to find people you ask her to call or message. You can allow only selected contacts.
Evie can read upcoming events when you ask what's on your calendar, and add events you ask her to put there.
Evie can read upcoming events on this iPhone when you ask what's on your calendar. Event details stay on device unless you ask.
Evie adds events you ask her to put on your calendar.
Evie creates reminders you ask for on this iPhone.
Evie creates reminders you ask for on this iPhone.
Evie uses your location when you ask where you are or for directions.
Evie can show a read-only snapshot of Health data you choose to share. Nothing is sent to a model without your Home Station policy.
Evie can notify you for timers and reminders she created.
Evie can set timers and alarms you ask for.
